Definition: from G1223 and the base of G32; to herald thoroughly:--declare, preach, signify.
BiblicalUsage: To declare abroad is to publish a thing widely, and the word stands in three very different mouths. Paul declares his purification in the temple, Jesus tells the disciples to preach the kingdom, and God declares to Pharaoh that His name will be published through all the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's name is declared whether men mean it or not. Pharaoh's hardness became the occasion for it, the disciples' preaching carried it, and the same name is still being published wherever the gospel goes.
